exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License communication embeds; keep authoring IP
smallest_mvp: Import one contractor-approved closure/access plan
main_dependency_or_risk: Exact works, schedule and access facts must come from operator
score_rationale: High explanatory value; enterprise updates and project data are substantial.

concept: Return world scenes and geographic context for an address to agent workflows.
target_buyer: Agent developers; property and travel platforms
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $99/month developer plan plus metered scene/API usage
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License API access; keep renderer and general engine IP
smallest_mvp: One address-to-scene tool with a narrow documented schema
main_dependency_or_risk: Web rendering, data provenance, usage rights and API operations
score_rationale: Broad potential but developer acquisition and service maintenance add work.

concept: Let studios build their own digital games on WorldEngine's real-place geometry and presentation.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $99/month developer tier; negotiated minimum and usage royalties
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License bounded runtime/SDK; retain owned franchises and engine IP
smallest_mvp: One documented scene loader and one playable partner sample
main_dependency_or_risk: SDK stability, support, provenance and third-party feed rights
score_rationale: High engine differentiation but developer platform work is large.

concept: Let students allocate a fictional budget to local street and park improvements.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $149/classroom/year or sponsored civic lesson pack
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License teaching edition; keep scenario framework
smallest_mvp: One fictional budget and replaceable street assets
main_dependency_or_risk: Costs are illustrative; not an engineering or municipal estimate
score_rationale: Good civic learning task with moderate buyer reach.

concept: Meet privately in a stylized favorite street or park with shared sky and memories.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $19.99/year per private room
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: Exclusive social experience; keep personal content private
smallest_mvp: Asynchronous notes in one shared place before live chat
main_dependency_or_risk: Realtime sync and private content storage; moderation if public
score_rationale: Emotional place angle but adds a new social-system burden.

concept: Compare intentionally captured scene versions and family memories as a neighborhood changes.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $19.99/year archive or $1,000 museum pilot
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: Retain personal archive; license heritage displays
smallest_mvp: Two explicitly dated snapshots and user notes
main_dependency_or_risk: Historical geometry is not already provided; capture and provenance needed
score_rationale: Unusual place memory product with substantial archive requirements.

concept: Log observed aircraft and replay verified permitted tracks above a chosen neighborhood.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $19.99/year or $1,000 museum demonstration license
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License museum editions; retain hobbyist logbook option
smallest_mvp: Manual sightings and imported licensed historical tracks
main_dependency_or_risk: Aircraft feed commercial/display rights and incomplete positions
score_rationale: Uses the sky/plane layer; data rights and hobby audience lower ease.

concept: Visualize proposed changes to real streets and open spaces.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $5,000 scoped pilot; annual licenses after workflow validation
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License professional workspace; no city-wide engine exclusivity
smallest_mvp: Import one consultant-supplied proposal layer
main_dependency_or_risk: Survey accuracy, GIS import, procurement and bespoke support
score_rationale: High project value but poor initial solo sales/build fit.

concept: Pin time-limited group notices to recognizable local corners in a private neighborhood world.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $49/month community edition
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License managed community editions; retain shared tools
smallest_mvp: Private invitation-only group with moderator-authored notices
main_dependency_or_risk: Content moderation, trust and privacy; no open public feed for MVP
score_rationale: Creates a different local communication task but adds social support.

concept: Play a digital pursuit game in a shared model of your real neighborhood.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $4.99 premium plus cosmetic packs
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: Exclusive game rules/community; license general world technology
smallest_mvp: Single-player bot pursuit before networked rooms
main_dependency_or_risk: Networking, cheating, moderation and mapping private areas
score_rationale: Compelling game space; multiplayer operations sharply reduce solo ease.

concept: Place installer-supplied solar layouts on a neighborhood scene to explain a customer's proposal.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $299/month installer license or $25 proposal render
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License to installers; keep calculation system outside engine
smallest_mvp: Import a verified installer layout and display it
main_dependency_or_risk: Roof geometry, engineering and yield models not supplied by engine
score_rationale: Paid buyer exists in hypothesis, but specialist inputs and sales are substantial.

concept: Turn buyer-supplied catchment and site information into a spatial presentation.
target_buyer: Retail property advisors; franchise development teams
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $500 presentation or $299/month team license
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License professional output/workspace
smallest_mvp: One site with supplied catchment overlays
main_dependency_or_risk: Footfall, demographics and economic analysis require other sources
score_rationale: Visual engine adds explanation rather than site-selection evidence.

concept: Visualize externally verified heat-risk information and organize outreach at local gathering places.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $3,000 scoped partner pilot
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License verified partner layers and visualization
smallest_mvp: Import one supplied heat layer and mark outreach stops
main_dependency_or_risk: Street-temperature/health-risk data and expert review not part of engine
score_rationale: Strong visual explanation; high data and institutional-sale burden.

concept: Build a reflective walking route using user-reviewed noise and sensory notes.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $19.99/year or $99/month organization plan
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License curated wellness routes; retain composer
smallest_mvp: User-reviewed route and guided audio with quietness unknown labels
main_dependency_or_risk: Noise and sensory data are not in engine; cannot infer quiet from geometry
score_rationale: Interesting wellbeing task but new evidence collection is the bottleneck.

concept: Help a trusted group divide search areas, record sightings and avoid duplicated effort.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test shelter-funded $49/month tool; free urgent consumer use
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License to shelters; protect personal/sighting data
smallest_mvp: Private search sectors and manually reported sightings
main_dependency_or_risk: Location privacy, false reports and urgent support; no pet tracking sensor
score_rationale: Useful pet adjacency, but crisis use and low direct payment limit rank.

concept: Provide a guided audio/haptic representation of a route for pre-trip familiarization.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test organization-funded $99/month pilot; free learner access
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License through specialist partners
smallest_mvp: A nonvisual landmark tour designed with target users
main_dependency_or_risk: Accessibility research and verified route cues; not real-time safety guidance
score_rationale: Useful inclusion angle but unfamiliar specialist product requirements.

concept: Preview inspection routes and attach supplied asset/tree tasks to the street world.
pricing_hypothesis_usd: Test $199/month crew workspace plus setup
exclusive_vs_license_recommendation: License specialist workspace
smallest_mvp: Import supplied inspection points and assignment notes
main_dependency_or_risk: Tree/utility asset datasets, GIS integration and ground verification
score_rationale: Mapping alone is insufficient; operational specialization reduces ease.
